In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the amorphous structure is not due to the small number of atoms, as is usually assumed, but that it is due to the large ionic radii.
the amorphization of the alkaline-earth-chalcogenides can be explained by a strong polarization of the ions, whereas the appearance of a new crystalline modification can be explained by ionic radii.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the amorphous state of the alkaline-earth chalcogenides can be explained by a high polarization of the ions in the lattice.
the crystallization of the alkaline-earth chalcogenides can be explained by ionic bonds.
